name: Algorithmic Recurrence Distillation
description: I removed the narrative framing of a two-stage physical process (machines, segments, waiting times) and replaced it with a deterministic, step-by-step procedural definition of the exact recurrence relation that calculates the makespan. This forces the model to recognize the algebraic structure of the 2-machine flow shop from the state updates of two accumulators, rather than relying on scheduling keywords.
